title: Solo Run Fest 2026 Review: What the 2026 Edition Was Like
seo_title: Solo Run Fest 2026 Review | Surakarta, Central Java
meta_description: Solo Run Fest 2026 review: about 7,000 runners from Stadion Manahan to Taman Balekambang on 27 September, up from about 5,000 the year before.
dek: Surakarta's flagship road race grew by about 2,000 runners in a year. Here is what the 27 September 2026 edition was like, from the reporting on it.
verdict: Solo Run Fest is the city of Surakarta's own flagship running event, and the 2026 edition showed it growing fast: about 7,000 runners on Sunday 27 September, up from about 5,000 the year before, including some from abroad [1]. The route ran from Stadion Manahan to Taman Balekambang across the half marathon, 10 km and 5 km [1]. The mayor ran the 5 km himself and said the event ran smoothly and that residents accepted the road closures well [1]. That verdict comes from the city that stages the race, not from runners. For an independent view, look for runner accounts before you enter.

sections.heading: The 2026 Edition in Numbers
paragraphs: Solo Run Fest 2026 was held on Sunday 27 September and drew about 7,000 runners from across Indonesia, including participants from abroad [1]. That was up from about 5,000 at the previous edition [1].

The race started at Stadion Manahan and finished at Taman Balekambang, a point-to-point route through the city rather than a loop from one venue [1]. There were three distances: the half marathon, a 10 km and a 5 km [1].

sections.heading: A City Council Race
paragraphs: This is a municipal event. Mayor Respati Ardi called it the flagship event of Kota Surakarta, part of a sport-tourism push aligned with the Central Java provincial government, and ran the 5 km with his wife [1]. He said the 2026 race ran neatly, that all went well, and that residents accepted an event that used several of the city's roads [1].

He also said the city is not only chasing numbers, but also the quality of the event and how satisfied runners and residents are [1]. Solo Run Fest is one of four running events the city says it has locked into its calendar, alongside the Mangkunegaran Run, Run for Humanity and the Soekarno Run [1].

sections.heading: Should You Enter Next Year?
paragraphs: If you want a mid-sized city race in Central Java with the backing of the local government, it is a reasonable choice, and a point-to-point route through Solo is a better way to see the city than laps of a stadium.

The limit of the evidence is that it comes from the organising city. Growth from about 5,000 to about 7,000 runners in a year is a good sign, but it is not the same as runners saying the course, water stations and timing were good. Look for race reports from the 2026 edition before you commit to travelling.
This review is compiled from published reporting on the 2026 edition. It is not a first-hand race report, and nobody from this site ran the race.

faqs.question: How many people ran Solo Run Fest 2026?
faqs.answer: About 7,000 runners, including some from outside Indonesia, took part on Sunday 27 September 2026. That was up from about 5,000 at the previous edition, a growth the city government presents as a sign that its sport-tourism strategy is working, while saying it also wants better quality, not just bigger fields.

faqs.question: Where does Solo Run Fest start and finish?
faqs.answer: In 2026 it started at Stadion Manahan and finished at Taman Balekambang, both in Surakarta (Solo), Central Java. That makes it a point-to-point route through the city rather than laps from one venue, so plan how you will get back to your hotel or car from the finish.

faqs.question: Who is behind Solo Run Fest?
faqs.answer: The Surakarta city government backs it and calls it the city's flagship sport-tourism event, alongside the Mangkunegaran Run, Run for Humanity and the Soekarno Run. Mayor Respati Ardi ran the 5 km in 2026 and said the event ran smoothly and that residents accepted the road closures.

editorial_notes: Rewritten 2026-09-28, the day after the 2026 race, about that edition. Replaces a pre-race preview. The only assessment of how the race went comes from the mayor, and it is attributed to him as such. No rating: nothing here is participant evidence.
